title: Irodora mockup element inventory
description: Golden rule 14, per element (F-220). One file per image in mockups/: every element the image draws, top to bottom, with its measured geometry, token, face, icon, binding and action. The text an image prints is not recorded as an element's content (R9-MOCKUP-FIDELITY §4 E1) — only its shape and script; a departure's why may quote the drawn construction it departs from. Generated from mockups/tools/inventory-data/NN.mjs by mockups/tools/generate-inventory.mjs; checked by scripts/verify-mockups.mjs, which reads its vocabulary from this file. The rules it applies are R9-MOCKUP-FIDELITY §2–§8.

mockup.description: The image's number; its file is the mockups/index.json row of the same id.

mockupSha256.description: The sha256 of the image this inventory was written against. It must equal the index row's sha256, or the elements may no longer be the ones drawn (E-126).

kind.description: screen: one route (or one state of one), measured at §2's scale. board: a sheet of components, a brand board or a states board — it fixes the vocabulary screens reference, and a screen wins where the two disagree (P3).

governs.description: What this image decides (§3). layout: a primary mockup (P1). palette / locale / state: a variant, which governs only that dimension of the route it varies (P2). vocabulary: a board (P3).

screens.description: The drawn screen(s) in image pixels, and the scale that maps each to the 384 dp reference (§2). A board may draw several devices; a full-bleed image has one screen, the whole width.

dpPerPx.description: 384 / the screen's inner width in px. null on a board sheet, which draws components at no screen's scale — its elements carry dp: null, and a screen decides their size (P3).

notDesign.description: Presentation artefacts (§2) — bezels, status bars, callouts, leaked prompt labels, garbled text, line-art outside a frame. Listed so that no feature builds one.

what.description: presentation: what the OS or the render's setting draws and no surface of the app does — a home indicator, the home screen an icon sits on, a faint mark in the render.

departures.description: Every place the build will not draw what the image draws. A departure exists only if R9-MOCKUP-FIDELITY §4 lists its rule (golden rule 14).

conflicts.description: Each §6 conflict that touches this image, the elements it decides, and whether the user flipped its default.

overhangs.description: Elements the image draws past its own screen's edge, each recorded as drawn only while an open question in PRD §10 asks what to build (fit it to the screen, or keep the drawn width). A child of a declared element overhangs through it. The record never decides the question.

order.description: A strict sequence within the file. A screen reads top to bottom, then left to right: elements sorted by top edge, where consecutive tops within 8 px (4 dp) chain into one row, and each row is read left to right. A board reads panel by panel — column by column, each column top to bottom — because its columns are unrelated groups, not one page.

screen.description: Which of frame.screens the element sits in — required where the image draws more than one. dp is measured from that screen's origin at its dpPerPx.

component.description: ui:<export of @irodora/ui>, new:<a component a feature must add to it>, or app:<a screen-local composition>. null for a pure container.

dp.description: The box at §2's scale — (box − screen origin) × dpPerPx, to the nearest half dp. Not snapped to the R9 scale: a token is chosen from it, it is not one. null on a board, where the render's scale is not a screen's.

size.description: A §5 step. caption marks an em measured below 12 dp, where §5 names no step (OQ-12 asks whether to add one); raw.emDp keeps the estimate. Siblings drawn alike take one step — the one most of them snap to, the smaller on a tie (§2).

binding.description: §8. static:<i18n key> · engine:<function> · corpus:<field> · store:<field> · derived:<feature> · route:<param> · oq:<OQ id>. null only for pure decoration, and on a board, whose samples show a component and bind nothing.

measured.description: Optional. Role → the hex actually read from the render (§2's method, ΔE00 ≈ 2 tolerance), kept for the appearance sweep (F-221). The token above is what the build uses (P4); this records how far the render sat from it.

raw.description: Optional. Readings kept beside a snapped value so a reviewer can see what the snap changed: emDp, the estimated em in dp (§2's glyph-class rule) wherever the size step moved it by more than 2 dp or the step is caption; cornerPx, a fitted corner radius in image px wherever the radius token moved it by more than 2 dp or the image has no scale.

copy.description: The shape of the text, never the text (E1).
